intro: Work in comfort, move with ease with Vurv. Our chair blends stylish colors with ergonomic support, making long hours feel lighter—whether at home or in the office.

features.title: Designed with flair
features.text: Available in bold duo-tone shades, this chair adds personality to your space while keeping a clean, professional look that fits modern workstations.

features.title: Breathe easy support
features.text: The broad mesh back provides excellent airflow and lumbar support, ensuring you stay cool and comfortable through long working hours.

features.title: Tilt your way to comfort
features.text: The center tilt mechanism allows personalized reclining so you can adjust posture and movement to match your work rhythm.

features.title: Cushion where it counts
features.text: A contoured foam seat ensures soft, supportive comfort while relieving pressure on the lower thighs during extended sitting sessions.

features.title: Lumbar love
features.text: Height-adjustable lumbar support lets you customize back support to match your spine’s natural curve—ideal for posture and back health.

features.title: Glide with confidence
features.text: 360° swivel and smooth-rolling twin-wheel castors offer effortless movement around your workspace without scratching floors.

name: Vurv High Back Knitted Fabric Mesh Ergonomic Workstation Chair Royal Blue
